data.text:
coming out a little bit from my break here.

some three months ago, i was given a once in a lifetime chance to meet @willashley05 up close dito sa japan, and until now it still feels unreal whenever i think about it. sa sobrang halo halo ng emotions ko noon, halos hindi ko ma process na andoon na siya, right in front of us. i couldn't even make myself step closer sa kanya at first, kasi para talaga akong nag freeze sa kinatatayuan ko. so we just stood a few feet away, telling him about the gifts his supporters all around the world prepared and all the well wishes sent from the philippines for his first out of the country trip after pbb collab. tas nung paalis na sya, dun lang talaga namin naipon yung lakas ng loob to ask for a photo and a signature, kasi gusto namin sulitin yung chance to talk to him, makipagkulitan, and just let him feel how loved he is.

it was this mix of gulat, kilig, pure happiness, pagod, excitement, lahat lahat na talaga. but the moment i saw him, everything made sense. every vote, every effort, every sleepless night, pati yung mga breakdown moments out of stress and worry, all of it felt worth it. kasi he is exactly the kind of person you'd be proud to root for. humble. warm. genuinely grateful. yung tipong kahit pagod ka na, one interaction with him reminds you why you chose him in the first place. the way he carries himself makes it so easy to support him. parang automatic, natural, parang hindi mo kayang bitawan kasi ang gaan nya suportahan.

meeting him didn't just make me proud of myself for being a fan. it made me proud of our whole fandom. kasi the kindness he shows reflects back sa atin. he's the kind of artist who makes his supporters feel seen, appreciated, and valued, kahit sa mundo ng iba fan ka lang. seeing him that close reminded me why we cheer for him, why we fight for him, why we stay. he has this softness and sincerity na ramdam mo agad, even in small moments.

and the way he shows gratitude sobraaaa talaga. he had already thanked me in person for delivering @willieversintl_ luggage gift, pero he still messaged me again after i got home. and i swear, it wasn't even in my bingo card that he'd reach out to me. siya pa mismo yung nag effort to send thanks ulit, kahit sobra sobra na yung pasasalamat nya in person. that's who he is. he remembers. he cares. he makes sure you feel appreciated in a way na hindi mo makakalimutan.

and honestly, that brief encounter is something i will carry with me for a very long time. yung tipong kahit tumagal na yung panahon, babalikan ko pa rin yung memory na yun. because moments like that remind you na tama yung pinili mong i support. tama yung nilaan mong oras, puso, at pagod. and with will, it's so easy to choose him every single time.

WILL ALWAYS BE HERE
WILL ALWAYS BE HERE
WILL ALWAYS BE HERE
#AlwaysWithWillAshley
